question: A running club logs its training in minutes and posts the monthly total in hours. The club had 124 numbered vests in its kit bag, and 95 of them were handed out for a race. Each vest still in the bag was paired with 4 safety pins from the box. 12 of those pins were bent and thrown away, and a member then brought 52 more pins. The coach kept half of the pins and gave the rest to the junior team. How many pins did the coach keep?

A community centre had 157 folding tables in its store. 4 tables were broken and taken away, and a donation brought in 12 more. The council then delivered enough tables to make the store hold 2 times as many as before. The tables were shared equally among the centre's 6 halls, and Farida took charge of the hall by the entrance. A school later lent her 75 more tables, leaving her with more tables than her colleague Omar has in his hall. How many tables are in Farida's hall?

A publisher printed 152 books on each of its 5 presses. Every book holds 7 chapters. After a rewrite the editors cut 3953 chapters from the run. Each chapter that was kept was set on 7 pages, and 2455 pages were then lost when a machine jammed. Every page that survived carries 3 illustrations. Ines checked more pages than her colleague Karl did, and a dozen proofreaders work for the publisher. How many illustrations are in the print run?

A print works counts its runs in sheets but quotes them to customers in reams. On Monday there were 150 boxes of paper in the store, and each box holds 5 packs. A courier then brought 10 more packs. All of the packs were shared equally among the works' 5 machines. Each pack loaded on a machine prints 9 posters, and every poster is folded into 2 leaflets. How many leaflets does one machine produce?

On Monday morning a wholesaler had 190 sacks of rice in the store. Before lunch a delivery added 29 sacks, and in the afternoon a second delivery added 66 more. In the early evening a customer returned 5 sacks. Every sack in the store is repacked into 9 small bags for the shops. A dozen trolleys stand by the loading door. How many bags of rice will the store hold?

On Monday morning a florist had 91 buckets of roses, and a grower delivered 13 more before noon. In the early afternoon 42 buckets were sold to a hotel. Later that afternoon each bucket still in the shop was divided into 3 vases. Every vase holds 7 roses, and in the evening 430 roses were used for a wedding. How many roses are left in the shop?

A vineyard had 224 rows of vines, and 44 rows were dug up after a frost. Each remaining row produced 9 crates of grapes this year. The harvest was split equally between the vineyard's 2 owners, Pilar and Ramon, so each of them took the same number of crates. A neighbour then gave Pilar 17 extra crates. How many crates does Pilar have?

A stadium kiosk counts its takings in cents and reports them in dollars. Before the match the kiosk had 51 boxes of pies, and the kitchen tripled the number of boxes it held. A late van brought 37 more boxes, and 31 boxes were sent over to another kiosk. Each box in the kiosk holds 9 pies, and a member of staff then carried in 9 loose pies. The stadium holds 40000 people. How many pies does the kiosk have?

A model railway club kept 211 lengths of track in each of its 3 storage boxes. A member donated 45 more lengths, and a shop gave 13 more. The club then used 653 lengths to build a layout for an exhibition. A grant doubled the number of lengths still in the store. A visitor later handed in 20 more lengths. How many lengths of track are in the store?

A theatre wardrobe counts its sewing time in minutes and reports it in hours. Yasmin's store held 133 rolls of fabric, a supplier delivered 76 more, and a closing shop sent 35 rolls after that. Each roll cuts into 9 costume panels. The wardrobe used 1503 panels for a musical and another 209 for a pantomime. Yasmin still has more panels than her colleague Ola has. How many panels are left in Yasmin's store?

A bottling plant measures its output in millilitres although the labels are printed in litres. The plant had 74 pallets ready, and a lorry brought 17 more. Each pallet holds 3 cases, every case holds 5 boxes, and every box holds 4 bottles. A returned order then added 62 bottles to the store, and a short extra run added 39 more. The plant employs 120 people. How many bottles are at the plant?

On Monday morning a food bank had 87 boxes of pasta, and a supermarket delivered 68 more before lunch. In the early afternoon a matched giving scheme doubled the number of boxes on the shelves. Later that afternoon a school brought 49 boxes and a church group brought 76. In the evening two neighbours dropped off 26 boxes and then 44 boxes. The food bank opens 5 days a week. How many boxes of pasta are on the shelves?

A youth choir had 66 songbooks in its cupboard, and a donation added 64 more. A printer then delivered enough copies to make the number of songbooks 2 times as large. A member brought 27 further books from home. Each songbook in the cupboard contains 7 songs. The choir rehearses in room 9. How many songs are printed in the cupboard's songbooks altogether?

Aiden's tile yard has 4 stacks, and each stack holds 161 tiles. A builder took 107 tiles for a bathroom. A cancelled job then returned 65 tiles to the yard. Later a school project used 207 tiles. Aiden keeps more tiles in his yard than his rival Beth does, and his van can carry 90 tiles at a time. How many tiles are in Aiden's yard?

A radio station measures its adverts in seconds but sells them to clients in minutes. On Monday the station had 214 advert slots booked. A new client then added 55 slots. A cancellation removed 57 slots, and a second cancellation removed 30 more. A car dealer finally booked 25 slots. How many advert slots are booked now?

Lars keeps 115 sheets of plywood in his workshop, and a supplier delivered 72 more. A kitchen job used 161 sheets, and a small repair used 9 more. A neighbour then returned 46 sheets that were the wrong size, and an auction added 24 sheets to the pile. Each sheet in the workshop can be cut into 7 shelves. Lars holds more plywood than his colleague Ida does, and his van is 5 metres long. How many shelves can Lars cut?

A brewery measures its beer in millilitres but sells it in litres. On Monday morning 227 barrels were rolled into the yard, and each barrel fills 5 casks. During the afternoon every cask was tapped into 6 jugs. In the evening 5877 jugs went out to the pubs of the town. A pub returned 41 jugs the next morning, and 467 jugs were then sent to a festival. How many jugs does the brewery still have?

A school had 94 recorders in its music room, and a grant paid for 62 more. 101 recorders were lent out to pupils for the term. Each recorder still in the room comes with 9 sheets of music in its case. The choir used 430 of those sheets for a concert, and a teacher then printed 27 more. A dozen music stands are kept in the corner, and the room is 12 metres wide. How many sheets of music are in the room?

A cafe records its baking times in minutes and writes them on the rota in hours. The cafe had 40 jars of jam in its pantry, and a second batch made the number of jars 2 times as large. A market stall then gave the cafe 66 more jars, and a neighbour brought 14. All of the jars were shared equally among the cafe's 5 branches. How many jars went to one branch?

A theatre workshop counts its rehearsal time in minutes and prints it on the call sheet in hours. The prop store held 130 wooden crates, and 128 of them were carried onto the stage for a play. Each crate left in the store was filled with 9 paper flowers. A dozen of those flowers were crushed and thrown away. A volunteer then made 55 more flowers for the store. How many paper flowers are in the store?

Rosa keeps 19 boxes of beads in her studio, and each box holds 6 strings of beads. A friend gave her 15 more strings. Rosa then cut every string she had into 5 short lengths for a workshop. A supplier sent her 29 more short lengths, and a shop donated 69. Rosa has more lengths of beads than her colleague Tariq has. How many short lengths does Rosa have?

A ferry company had 145 lifejacket lockers on its quay, and 85 lockers were moved to a new pier. Each locker still on the quay holds 8 boxes, and every box holds 9 lifejackets. A safety audit then added 64 lifejackets to the quay. The company shipped 3173 lifejackets out to its island route. The ferry crossing takes 40 minutes. How many lifejackets are on the quay?

A wildlife park had 168 bags of feed in its store, and a delivery added 12 more, followed by 3 bags from a neighbour. Each bag was then tipped into 3 buckets for the keepers. A supplier sent 41 more buckets to the store. Every bucket holds 7 scoops of feed. The park keeps 60 species of animals. How many scoops of feed does the park have?

A charity shop had 123 bags of clothes in the back room, and volunteers brought in 31 more and then 79 more. Each bag holds 5 items of clothing. The shop sold 74 items on Saturday, and a donation then added 32 items to the racks. Marta has sorted more bags than her colleague Jonas has, and a dozen new coat hangers were bought for the shop. How many items of clothing does the shop have?

A seed company filled 209 sacks and split every sack into 6 tins for its shops. The tins were shared equally among the company's 6 shops, and Nell took the tins for the shop in the valley. Each tin in her shop holds 7 packets, every packet holds 8 envelopes, and every envelope holds 3 seeds. Nell's shop received more tins than Owen's smaller kiosk did last season, and a dozen shelves line her back wall. The company was founded 90 years ago. How many seeds are in Nell's shop?
